title: Daily Boss Per Player
description: Makes Daily Boss cooldowns per-player instead of server-wide.
body:
# Daily Bosses Per Player

## Summary

Makes Daily Boss cooldowns per-player instead of server-wide.

## Description

Daily Bosses Per Player is a lightweight addon for the Daily Boss mod that changes the boss activation cooldown from one shared server-wide cooldown to individual player cooldowns.

Normally, when one player activates the Daily Boss, the whole server has to wait before anyone can activate it again. With this addon, each player gets their own cooldown, making Daily Boss more friendly for multiplayer servers.

## Features

- Per-player Daily Boss activation cooldowns
- Lets different players activate the Daily Boss on their own schedule
- Saves cooldown data per player
- Keeps the original Daily Boss encounter behavior
- No new bosses, items, blocks, or worldgen
- Lightweight addon for server/modpack use

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge
- Daily Boss

## Install Notes

Install alongside the Daily Boss mod. The logic runs server-side, but installing on both client and server is recommended for modpacks.
